children: Arcturus reported interim Phase 2 data for ARCT-810 in OTC deficiency and introduced LUNAR 2.0, which showed up to ~40-fold potency gains in NHPs. It plans to integrate ARCT-2601 into the ongoing Phase 2 near year-end, and agreed to acquire myNEO, expected to close in October.
Clinical signal supports platform validity and future path in OTCD, a rare liver disorder with high unmet need.
LUNAR 2.0 up to 40x potency in NHP
If translatable, could enable lower/less frequent dosing and broaden pipeline potential.
Accelerates next-gen program by integrating into current Phase 2, tightening timelines.
Regulatory clarity reduces development risk for ARCT-2601.
Adds AI engine to improve mRNA design and target ID; potential R&D leverage.

This marks mid-stage validation for Arcturus’ liver mRNA platform while pivoting to a more potent delivery system. A larger catalyst would be statistically robust Phase 2 efficacy and safety for ARCT-810/2601 and confirmation that LUNAR 2.0 gains translate in humans.
